neighbours.label: 'If'/'IF'/'if' as the start of a name, acronym or command rather than the conditional (Ifremer, Ifugao, IFM, ifup)
fire: The deep-sea submersible was operated by Ifremer from Brest.
The rice terraces were carved by the Ifugao people centuries ago.
Visitors can find IFM at stand D12 in hall nine.
After editing the config, run ifup eth0 to start the interface.
The report followed the IFRS accounting standards.
Researchers at the IFO institute published a new survey.
The loan was approved by the IFC last spring.
Our network script calls ifdown before changing the address.
quiet: The deep-sea submersible can dive if the weather is calm.
The rice terraces would collapse if nobody repaired them.
Visitors can find us at stand D12 if they ask at the desk.
After editing the config, check if the interface is up.
The report asked if the accounting standards were met.
Researchers asked if the new survey was reliable.
The loan would be approved if the bank agreed.
Our network script checks if the address has changed.

notes: The + pole fires on conditional ' if'/' when'; near misses here use conditional 'if'.
